CustomField.description: If Case is Closed, calculate days between creation and closure of Case. If Case is still open, calculate days between created date and today
CustomField.formula: IF ( IsClosed = TRUE , IF ( DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) = DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) , 1 , DATEVALUE( ClosedDate ) - DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ) ),TODAY() - DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ))
CustomField.label: Case Age (Days)
